start_modes.template: Start from the DRBR starting save every time (default)
start_modes.continue: Continue from my last DRBR save; the starting save when there is none or it is not valid

notes: The DRBR save profile. This file matches drbr.json's save_profile (scripts/validate-save.py checks it). DRBR Launcher writes the installed profile's versions to %LOCALAPPDATA%\DRBR\save-profile\profile.json, and the game reads drbr_data\drbr_profile.cfg. See docs/SAVE_SYSTEM.md.
